title: 1000 Islands - Sign Man Fishing Charters @ French Bay Marina
specs: Two United States Coast Guard inspected boats

services.name: Pike Charters
services.desc: These wary fish are known for their elusive habits as well as their fantastic flavor. They are long distance swimmers and it is not uncommon for them to travel more than 15 miles in a single night to find their preferred water temperature or food source. Another outstanding characteristic of the walleye is their eyes.

blurb: They provide fishing trips on two United States Coast Guard inspected boats. The season runs from May through November 30. They cater to families with small children, first time anglers, and pros.
highlights: Two United States Coast Guard inspected boats

quotes.text: Captain Rich is the man. Works super hard to put you on fish regardless of how difficult the fishing is. We went in the slow season for bass, fishing deep water. Rich still put us on a lot of fish and we caught a lot of really nice bass and pike. He’s a great coach and you will leave a better fisherman. Whatever you think you know, Rich knows more. Would definitely fish with him again. He gives 110% effort to finding fish and helping you catch them.

Capt. Rich was amazing! We had a wonderful day of fishing and limited out on fish caught! If you go with Sign Man Charters, Capt. Rich doesn't disappoint! He will teach you how to catch! He has a great sense of humor and everything we needed! Capt. Rich also cut and cleaned our fish in record time! We added the lunch food basket and it was great! We look forward to our next excursion! We recommend the full day charter! Excellent!

We just finished up yesterday (7/15/24) and had an awesome time. Forget what you think you know, listen to Capt. Rich, and you'll do well. You could probably go to any guide to catch quantity, but if you're looking for big, heavy bass and pike, (and musky, although that wasn't our target species) Rich is the guy. There is no substitute for his experience on the St. Lawrence.
Captin Rich knows where to find the fish. This is my second trip out with him hunting for musky and pike. My fishing partner and I are working on setting up next October.
Rich was outstanding to spend the day with. We caught 14 bass including three over 18”. A great time and a great charter captain!
We had a great time out on the water and I caught my first musky. All great equipment and easy to use!
